requirements_and_criteria.definition: Specify MUST own `planned` to `specced`, Implement MUST own `specced` to `in-progress`, and Close Out MUST own `in-progress` to `implemented`. Each owning phase MUST expose its prior/resulting state and supporting evidence. Selection MUST remain identity-only and MUST NOT apply these milestones. Reconciliation of stale earlier state MUST follow FR-034 rather than silently skipping transitions. [Operator amendment and governing boundary](#lifecycle-amendment-traceability-and-delivery-boundary)

requirements_and_criteria.definition: Specify MUST record `specced` only after the exact active specification is authored or amended, author quality checks are satisfied, required clarification and independently assigned review/roadmap-brief findings are resolved, unique roadmap/spec linkage and current prerequisites are valid, and no unapproved consequential decision remains. Implementation completion and future outcome proof MUST NOT be required for this authoring milestone. File presence, a Complete label, author self-check or command exit alone MUST NOT substitute for the missing evidence.
requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: Implement MUST revalidate the current target, unique linkage, dependency readiness, reviewed specification/plan/tasks and preparation readiness, and confirm an eligible operator-authorized implementation scope before recording `in-progress`. That effect MUST precede substantive coding. Blocked preflight/readiness or unavailable required assignments MUST NOT advance the state. `in-progress` MUST describe authorized implementation activity without claiming completion or verification.
requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: Close Out MUST record `implemented` only when current attributable completion/convergence evidence and independently assigned review substantiate the full selected feature scope, required implementation validation is satisfied and no unresolved buildable implementation defect remains. Task checkboxes, successful commands, a Complete label or historical convergence on older artifact contents alone MUST NOT establish this milestone. Separately owned future human acceptance and post-closeout release obligations MUST remain visible and pending without being misclassified as completed or as buildable implementation defects.
requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: Close Out MUST record the substantiated `implemented` milestone before proposing `verified` through the existing roadmap-debrief prerequisites and explicit consequential verification gate. The implementation milestone MUST NOT satisfy that gate. Verification return or deferral MUST retain the completed milestone; no lifecycle result MUST imply Git integration, publication or feature/The Diagram acceptance. [Closeout boundary, S021](../../wiki/pages/closeout-and-verification-boundary.md)
requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: After the lifecycle contract and necessary governing changes are explicitly approved and delivered into the installed workflow, a trusted invocation of the owning phase for the exact feature MUST authorize its declared routine evidence-supported advancement without another approval solely for derived patch wording. The invocation, governing contract, current evidence and resulting effects MUST remain inspectable. This prospective requirement MUST NOT grant the present authoring run roadmap mutation authority or bypass existing installed rules.
requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: Immediately before each lifecycle effect, the workflow MUST revalidate the current roadmap, active identity, unique mapping, dependencies, relevant evidence freshness and governing state. Material change MUST invalidate an earlier proposal/approval for the changed effect and cause fresh assessment or focused resolution. Every permitted effect MUST preserve unrelated entry fields, earlier verification provenance and history; evidence/proposals/child outputs MUST NOT become trusted operator decisions.
requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: An owning phase MUST retain a consistently equal or more advanced state after current validation without automatic downgrade, duplicate transition/event, fabricated history, reset of prior evidence or redundant routine approval. Later state alone MUST NOT establish missing evidence. Inconsistent advanced-state evidence MUST produce the exact gap or focused conflict resolution rather than blind retention as proof of completion.
requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: Each affected owning workflow MUST declare how it reconciles a stale earlier entry within its approved invocation scope before continuing. Each missing milestone MUST have its own current substantiation and a permitted ordered transition; later labels and completed tasks MUST NOT silently skip milestones or invent past transition dates. Effects MUST record their actual present occurrence and truthful historical evidence. Adequately evidenced work MUST NOT be repeated solely to repair lifecycle bookkeeping. Missing proof or an absent authorized installed route MUST yield an exact blocker with safe resumption, not authority to invoke a different workflow.
requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: Ambiguous or contradictory identity, linkage, scope, evidence, transition authority or recovery MUST stop for focused operator resolution before the disputed effect. Deferred/abandoned reactivation, requested regression, material scope/product changes and constitutional/authority amendments MUST retain explicit human decisions. Missing/failed prerequisites or unavailable exact assignments MUST instead be reported as attributable blockers with safe resumption; a blanket approval question MUST NOT override them.
requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: A successful lifecycle write followed by a later failure, or successful earlier phase work followed by a failed write, MUST retain truthful separate outcomes and current evidence for resumption. The workflow MUST report exactly which effects occurred and which did not, without automatic rollback, guessed repair or overall completion claim. Every retry MUST revalidate current state/evidence and MUST NOT reuse an earlier approval after material change.
requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: Delivery MUST reconcile affected governing contracts, reviewed owning workflows, extension lifecycle boundaries and user-facing guidance before relying on changed authority, preserving manual fallback and component ownership. requirements_and_criteria.definition: Validate all three owning phases against successful transitions, missing/stale proof, repeat/equal/advanced states, stale `planned` recovery of all required milestones, contradictory recovery, missing routes, deferred/abandoned states, partial failures and concurrent relevant-state changes. requirements_and_criteria.definition: Implement MUST establish its requested scope from the trusted operator instruction and current selected feature/task identities. A full-feature invocation without an explicit task restriction MUST include all existing unfinished requested tasks, including those currently blocked on dependencies or decisions. An explicitly bounded task selection MUST remain bounded. A generated reviewer eligibility list, task recommendation or external report MUST NOT narrow, broaden or replace operator authority. Requested scope and its provenance MUST remain inspectable; new material scope requires an explicit decision. requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: Implement MUST maintain a separately revalidated executable subset of the authorized task scope, with each pending task's prerequisites and actual blocker reason. Eligibility assessment MUST NOT discard initially blocked scoped tasks or reinterpret their later activation as scope expansion. Scope, current eligible/pending IDs and completion evidence MUST remain distinguishable, and overall completion MUST account for all required requested work rather than only the initial eligible subset.
requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: Before substantive correction, Implement MUST retain attributable evidence for the full requested task scope, including initially blocked tasks, and immutable before evidence for known code defects. Later eligibility reassessment MUST preserve that scope provenance, earlier defect identities, correction history and partial effects. Newly eligible tasks MAY receive fresh task-specific evidence before their execution, but MUST NOT replace earlier before evidence or retrospectively add findings to it. An operational eligibility change MUST NOT be mislabeled as a new scope authorization or erase prior findings.
requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: After independently substantiated progress, prerequisite completion or an actual settled consequential answer, Implement MUST reassess current scoped-task eligibility before choosing its continuation or terminal result. When safe authorized work is available and applicable readiness, authority, review, progress and iteration guards permit execution, it MUST continue newly eligible existing scoped tasks in the same invocation without redundant task authorization or another invocation solely because the initial eligible subset was exhausted. A blocked task MUST NOT cause a scope-exhaustion stop while other safe authorized work remains executable under the common guards.
requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: Substantiated prerequisite completion or an actual operator answer MAY permit eligibility reassessment and first authorized execution; it MUST NOT itself count as code-defect resolution or substantive implementation progress. Decision, checklist, marker and report changes alone MUST earn zero implementation-progress credit and MUST NOT renew a stalled correction loop or reset its budget. Continued correction MUST satisfy FR-025's independent implementation-evidence guard. Consequential input MUST use the existing focused main-task gate and same-child relay; settled same-scope answers MUST NOT require routine reauthorization.
requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: Independent progress assessment MUST compare implementation evidence against the actual pre-correction scope and known-defect record. Only a previously unfinished scoped task completed with relevant implementation evidence or a previously recorded in-scope code defect resolved with fresh independent evidence MAY earn implementation-progress credit. New findings discovered after correction MUST remain new unresolved obligations until independently substantiated; they MUST NOT retrospectively earn resolution credit. Stable findings, task ownership, unresolved/new defects and historical correction evidence MUST survive eligibility changes without renaming or omission to claim progress.
requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: Same-invocation continuation MUST preserve current readiness, unchanged authority, exact available assignments, safe permitted effects, independent review and the declared iteration budget. Missing/stale proof, genuine unresolved decisions, unavailable dependencies/routes/assignments, unsafe effects, no substantive correction progress and the cap MUST retain their specific stops and safe resumption. Where only one task is blocked, other scoped tasks MAY proceed only if all applicable common guards permit it; global readiness or assignment failure MUST NOT be bypassed. Exhaustion of the initial eligible subset alone MUST NOT be a stop when FR-042 permits other authorized work.
requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: A requested task's external component ownership MUST NOT by itself exclude it from Implement scope or authorize additional effects. Before execution, the controller MUST validate the actual source checkout, available access, applicable owner guidance, permitted source-work route and task authority, respecting source ownership and existing change-control boundaries. A missing installed owner capability that the authorized task exists to build or deliver MUST NOT itself block inspection or otherwise permitted owner-source work; that capability remains a prerequisite before effects that actually consume it. Missing source/access/source-work route, conflicting rules, unavailable authority or an unsafe effect MUST yield the actual blocker and resumption action rather than an assumed exclusion, generic fallback, blanket approval or unrequested cross-repository repair. [Component boundaries](../../.specify/memory/constitution.md#iii-generic-source-and-component-boundaries)
requirements_and_criteria.automated_validation_status: covered by named fixture cases; current source and case proof reconciled

requirements_and_criteria.definition: Continuation, blocking and completion reports MUST distinguish the trusted requested task scope, current executable subset, completed effects, remaining tasks, unresolved findings, actual operator decisions and stop reason. requirements_and_criteria.definition: Validate full-feature and explicit-subset requests, initially blocked task activation after prerequisite/decision completion, the T050/T051-to-T052 same-invocation regression, immutable before evidence and new defects, readiness/assignment failure, external-owner permission/route failure, actual scope changes, partial effects, no-progress and cap stops.
